subject: default inits to [-0.5,0.5] + null character in output

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: default inits to [-0.5,0.5] + null character in output
parts:
I just created an issue to change this:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/503

It's probably a one or two character change in the
code with a similarly trivial change in the doc.

The problem is testing --- we have instituted a
very strict every-change-must-be-tested policy that
doesn't mean just running it, but having a repeatable
unit test in code.

Daniel -- is this going to be easy to test? If
so, would you mind making this change?

I don't think we want to do it for 2.1.1 --- it should
go into 2.2.0, which is the milestone I put in for
the change.

-------------------

The null character in the output is another issue
that is also going to be trivial to change but hard
to test. I fear it's going to tank all the brittle tests
that are in place that inspect the command-line output
for character spans.

- Bob
